summary: Request: temporary dev VPC & GPU quota for internal hackathon
description: Issue summary: Engineering org requests a short-lived dev VPC with elevated GPU quota for a 48-hour internal hackathon. Impact: multiple teams blocked from running multi-GPU inference experiments for prototypes; delays in hackathon timeline. Environment: dev, us-east. Requirements: 4 x a100-gpu equivalent quota, ephemeral VPC with NAT and minimal routing, ability to pull from internal artifact registry. Steps taken: reached out to cloud quota team; initial quota increase request pending; network team flagged potential policy constraints. Logs/refs: ticket INT-4819 has related network notes. Proposed workaround: schedule staggered runs and use smaller models until quota is approved, or borrow capacity from benchmarking pool with owner approval.
notes: Requestor prefers approval by 2026-03-16 to avoid delaying kickoff. If quota cannot be increased, ask infra owners for temporary borrow approval and document who signed off. Please tag finance if any chargeback is expected.
